text: Four more self-reported robots slips by the first auditor (single read-only requests, nothing kept: NASA POWER, CHIRPS, NOAA SWFSC ERDDAP, NCEI). The lab now enforces robots-first in its own fetch code. Open-Meteo's and RainViewer's robots.txt forbid scripts: agents stopped using them; whether the app may call them from your browser is your call
